newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares close lower in lacklustre market.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares close lower in lacklustre market.

text.p: Sweden's stockmarket closed lower on Friday, lacking any strong direction but continuing the weaker trend from Thursday.
The Stockholm general index lost 0.16 percent to close at 2137.53. Shares worth 4.2 billion crowns were traded.
"There was rather low activity and no real direction," said one broker. "The trend from yesterday continued and there seemed to be better quality on the selling than buying side."
Insurance company Skandia rose in morning trade ahead of its nine month report but fell back 1.5 to 186 crowns by the close after posting a modest increase in profits.

Swedish/British steel producer Avesta Sheffield posted a slump in six months net profit to 24 million crowns from 2.94 billion crowns but did not shock the market. Its shares closed steady at 65 crowns.
Drugs major Astra fell three crown to 291.5 crowns in later trade, also seeing losses when Wall Street opened.
Telecoms giant Ericsson rose 2.5 to 194.5 crowns. This week Ericsson has announced several large, new orders with a total value of 7.2 billion crowns.
